cause: The DM wrote three guards coming up the stair one reply and a dozen boots the next, turning a figure of speech into a different number although the notes said shifts of three.
The DM had settled on a night's march from the children's road (round 64), but the old 'three days' road' from the Goat's Throat leg stayed in the notebook and it fell back on that figure.
The DM wrote and sealed the rider's recall in round 82, but never recorded it was sent; the notebook later said 'rider not recalled', so round 90 went back to the open threat with no explanation.
The player moved Korvash from the floor to the door and then smashed the desk lantern in one action, and the DM narrated it as written without fixing who stood where.
Forty spears was only ever in the conversation, never the notebook; in round 115 the DM invented a desertion of Brakk and nine Tally-sworn without adjusting the column count it had given.
In one reply the DM wrote that Tessa had been to the Goat's Throat a dozen nights while she says she has not seen the cairn since.
The goat was tied at the cairn in round 110 and brought along to the ledge in 111 with no untying written down; the notebook kept the tied version and round 112 used it.

Ushk's backstory of finding the ledge three days after the raid was made up on the spot and does not square with eleven tally marks and the children staying there, though the timing could be read to fit.
Day 22 was the first night on the road, but Gorrak calls it the second night (counting from Greyshaft's night), a loose ordinal; the notebook had the correct 'night of Day 22'.
Hale agreed to lend ponies earlier in the same reply, then the closing paragraph said 'a stolen pony', and put Pip at Veshra's gate while the party stood at the Stones.
Brakk's eyes flutter at 8 AM but the next reply has him waking at dusk; the DM skipped time and did not reconcile 'beginning to wake' with the later waking.
The DM narrated Cloak 3 going 'down in a heap' though the tracker (and notebook) had him standing at 1 HP, so he was still in the fight next round.
The notebook named Cloaks 7, 8 and 11 as having dropped bows, but the morale roll in round 143 treated Cloak 8 as a fresh fighter and he shot Korvash.
The DM offered to start a new character in round 144 without checking its tools, then found in round 145 that they only add companions to an existing party.
Greyshaft is north (round 135) but also described earlier as north and east over the high ground, so the rider fleeing east toward it is loose rather than flatly wrong.
Skarn said he was the senior one left; in round 155 the DM invented Tolk, a senior deputy with twenty cloaks, and had Skarn reveal him, though Skarn could have been boasting or lying.
The same reply says the shield is propped against the knee and then that the arms ache from holding it.
The DM narrated four, three more, then seven more laying down bows (14), while the tracker removed 4 and then 7 more (11); it did not tally the numbers it wrote.
The notebook and Brun's report said the cloaks had no shields, but the DM used the stock hobgoblin stats (AC 18, longsword and shield) and then described Tolk and Skarn with shields and longswords.
